title: micro-surge-cost-tether-and-coverage-sampler-nov-2027
summary: One-off tracker to quickly estimate manual surge coverage, approximate incremental cost impact, and owner handoffs for a short multi-region traffic spike. Lightweight rows for rapid handoff and 24h patch decisions.
rows: 1,Priya Nambiar,ops-coverage,us-west,/v1/generate,6,18,high,spin up burst pool + prefix cache priming,kv-cache cold for long-context tests,JIRA-OPS-8123
2,Ethan Morales,platform,eu-central,/chat/stream,12,24,critical,route to dedicated low-latency pool + throttle non-critical consumers,may require quota bump from infra,GHPR-4421
3,Lina Zhou,product-hosted-api,ap-southeast,/embed,4,6,medium,enable embedding cache + lower-replica concurrency for background jobs,embedding QPS surge from partner beta,PR-108
4,Marco Silva,serving-runtime,us-east,/rerank,3,2,low,temporary downgrade quant-profile for batch re-rerank,quality delta unknown,JIRA-ENG-2950
5,TBD,customer-success,global,/billing/usage,8,0,low,notify customers of transient degradation via status page,and monitor cost telemetry,INC-770
calculation_notes: Estimate rules: 1 GPU-hour approximates 3k tokens/sec sustained for small models; for burst pools assume 20% overhead. est-addl-gpu-hours = ceil(expected-spike-hours * baseline-concurrency * model-cost-factor). We used conservative model-cost-factor=1.2 for planning.
